text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During break between tasks, resting on 
rooftop—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... One trendy carrot moosn frozn, 
please!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Nwah, messed up again! M-Mousse, froo... 
zn, rosen?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Uuu! No good. Can't order at sophisticated 
city cafe like this.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Carrot mousse frozen? Talking about that 
buzzed cafe?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Eh... Aaaah!? C-City-san!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Practicing ordering? Why?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... Wanted to look cool and suave like 
you, City-san...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm? Just matter of getting used to it. 
Let's test it... Yeah, follow me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Eh, ehh!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Target cafe is far, so let's wander around 
here today and get used to vibe.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Fashionable district with City-san!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Fashionable district, whatever... No need 
to stress, just act normal.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
B-But if I mess up and show I'm country 
bumpkin, even City-san might...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Country or city doesn't matter. Would you 
laugh if I messed up, Yukino?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No way, never! Anyone can make mistake—... 
Ah.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
See? Nothing embarrassing about messing 
up. Besides, go for broke, right?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa... Go for broke! Sounds so urban 
and cool!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: City-san! Feel like I can do it now...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That's spirit. Let me know when you go to 
cafe. I'll come along.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Really!? Yay! Nothing to fear now!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Pfft... Exaggerating much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching Yukino Bijin fire herself up 
repeating "go for broke", Gold City let 
out small laugh.
